product.description: Într-o călătorie la Monte Carlo, în calitate de domnișoară de companie a unei doamne din lumea bună, timida eroină din Rebecca se îndrăgostește de Maxim de Winter, un văduv deosebit de chipeș. Deși cererea lui în căsătorie o ia prin surprindere, ea acceptă fericită să se mărite cu el. Dar când ajung la Manderley, moșia soțului său, aflată pe coasta Cornwall-ului, Maxim pare total schimbat, iar tânăra soție este înspăimântată. Naivă și lipsită de experiență, fără prieteni în conacul izolat, își dă seama că abia îl cunoaște. Iar în fiecare colț al fiecărei odăi se află fantoma frumoasei sale prime soții, Rebecca, a cărei amintire este păstrată vie de teribila doamnă Danvers...   „Cu una dintre cele mai evocatoare fraze de deschidere scrise vreodată, romanul lui Daphne du Maurier are tot ceea ce un cititor și-ar putea dori… Emoționant și tulburător de romantic, Rebecca a devenit bestseller imediat după apariție și a continuat să farmece într-un fel sinistru de atunci încoace.“ Marie Claire   „Unul dintre cele mai influente romane ale secolului XX. O carte uimitoare.“ Sarah Waters   „Cartea pe care orice scriitor ar vrea s-o fi scris.“ Clare Mackintosh

# Rebecca by Litera - A Classic Mystery Novel

Immerse yourself in the haunting beauty and psychological suspense of *Rebecca*. From **Litera**, this acclaimed piece of fiction transports readers to the glamorous coastlines and enigmatic estates that define Daphne du Maurier's masterpiece. If you are searching for a captivating mystery novel or classic literary fiction, *Rebecca* promises an unforgettable journey into secrets, desire, and the powerful ghost of the past.

## About the Book: A Tale of Secrets at Manderley

The story begins with the protagonist finding herself on a trip to Monte Carlo, accompanying a woman from high society. There, she falls for Maxim de Winter, a devastatingly charming widower. Though his unexpected proposal brings immediate happiness, life takes a startling turn when they arrive at Manderley, Maxim's grand estate on the Cornish coast.

The honeymoon period quickly fades into suspense. The young bride, naive and inexperienced, struggles in the isolated mansion. As she tries to build a new life with Maxim, she realizes how little she truly knows about him. Worse still, every corner of the luxurious dwelling seems haunted by the beautiful memory of his first wifeâRebecca herselfâa presence meticulously preserved by the formidable Mrs. Danvers.

*Rebecca* is more than just a mystery; it is an exploration of identity, class, and the enduring power of memory.

## Critical Acclaim: Why *Rebecca* Endures

Daphne du Maurier's novel has cemented its place as one of the most influential pieces of 20th-century literature. Critics have praised its evocative writing and enduring atmosphere:

> "With one of the most evocative opening lines ever written, Daphne du Maurierâs novel has everything a reader could wantâ¦ Moving and darkly romantic, *Rebecca* became an instant bestseller and continues to fascinate." â *Marie Claire*

The book's masterful blend of romance, suspense, and gothic atmosphere ensures it remains a favorite for readers worldwide.

## Product Details

*   **Title:** Rebecca
*   **Author:** Daphne du Maurier (Implied by context/description)
*   **Genre:** Fiction / Mystery
*   **Publisher:** Litera
*   **Price:** 54.99

Don't miss your chance to experience this timeless classic. Order *Rebecca* today and unravel the secrets hidden within Manderley Manor.

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What genre is *Rebecca*?**
*Rebecca* falls into the categories of gothic fiction, mystery, and romantic suspense, making it ideal for fans of literary thrillers.

**Is this a new release or a classic?**
It is a critically acclaimed classic that continues to appeal to modern readers due to its timeless themes of secrecy and identity.

**Where can I find more books by Litera?**
You can browse the full catalog of available titles on the [Litera website](https://www.litera.ro/).
